hero.title: Your library, volume by volume.
hero.lead: What you own down to the volume and the edition, where you are in your reading, and what comes next in the series you follow.
hero.eyebrow: For novel readers and manga collectors

cta.label: Sign in or create an account
cta.beta: Open beta: this instance is a test environment, and its data can be reset without notice.

own.title: What I own
own.body: Down to the volume and the edition: publisher, language, pages, ISBN. Enough not to buy a book twice in a bookshop.

progress.title: Where I am
progress.body: Books in progress, the page you reached, dates, a private rating and review, an annual goal and the pace to hold.

next.title: What is coming
next.body: Announced releases for the series you follow, and a wishlist ordered by urgency with its budget.

series.title: A series is not a pile of books
series.body: The deliberate difference: other tools reason in standalone books. Here a run reads at a glance — read, on the shelf, missing — and an absent volume goes to the wishlist in one gesture.
series.alt: Example: twelve volumes of a series, each marked read, owned or missing.

manga.title: You collect manga
manga.body: Twenty-five runs in progress: knowing which volume is missing matters more than the list.

novels.title: You read novels
novels.body: Follow your progress, hold a goal across the year, find again what you enjoyed.

import.title: You come from Booknode or Babelio
import.body: Your library comes with you: statuses, ratings, reading dates, series.

features.title: What is online today
features.collection: Collection in covers shelved by series, search, sorting, categories
features.discover: Search Open Library, the BnF and AniList, by title, author or ISBN
features.wishlist: Wishes ordered by urgency, estimated budget, "I bought it"
features.stats: Annual goal, pace, breakdown by genre and by author
features.import: Import from Booknode, Babelio, Goodreads or a CSV file
features.export: JSON and CSV export, account and data deletion
features.themes: Four light and dark themes, in French and English

closing.title: Start with one volume.
closing.body: Your ratings and reviews stay private, and are never aggregated across users.

mock.alt: A glimpse of the application: a collection shelved by series and the book being read.

reading.title: Where you stand, at a glance
reading.body: The page you reached, the day you finished, your private rating and review. A goal for the year, the pace to keep, and your reading history month by month.
reading.alt: Example: a yearly goal 70% reached and a year of reading month by month.

import.title: Bring your library along
import.body: No need to type it all again: your Booknode or Babelio library comes over in one click, with your statuses, ratings and reading dates. Missing covers and ISBNs fill themselves in.
import.step1: Drag the collect button to your bookmarks.
import.step2: Open your Booknode or Babelio library and click it.
import.step3: Import the file it gives you: your books are there, shelved by series.

import.title: Import my library
import.description: From Booknode or Babelio — by username, or with the collector in your browser — or from a CSV file (Goodreads…).
import.babelioNote: Babelio only shows your library to you, signed in: use the collector below, which reads it from your browser.
import.file: Import a file (collected, CSV or saved pages)

collector.title: Collect from your browser — always works
collector.step1: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:

step2.booknode: Open your Booknode profile page and click the bookmark: it goes through every page of your library and downloads a librarius-booknode.json file.
step2.babelio: Open “Mes livres” on Babelio, signed in, and click the bookmark: it goes through every page of your library and downloads a librarius-babelio.json file.

collector.step3: Import that file with the button below.
collector.copy: On mobile: copy the bookmark's code
collector.copied: Code copied: create a bookmark and paste it as its address.
collector.notCollected: This file was not produced by the Librarius collector.

import.failedTitle: The import did not go through

export.title: Export my data
export.description: Get your whole library back: collection, wishlist, reading, ratings, goals and categories.
export.hint: The JSON holds everything and can be imported back here. The CSV opens in a spreadsheet and carries the columns Goodreads and Booknode use.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently erase your account and all your data.
deleteAccount.warning: This cannot be undone: your collection, your wishlist, your reading, your goals and your sign-in are deleted, with no way back.
deleteAccount.kept: The book records (titles, editions, series) stay in the shared catalog: they are not yours and they serve the other readers. Nothing there says you owned them.
deleteAccount.delay: Erasure in the database is immediate. The encrypted backups of the database, however, are kept for up to six months: your data lives on in them until the last backup holding it expires, and is only restored in the event of a major incident.
deleteAccount.done: Your account and all your data have been deleted. Thank you for using My Library.
deleteAccount.failed: Cannot delete it right now. Nothing has been deleted.
